personality_one_liner: A deeply welcoming, highly accessible community space that feels like walking into a friendly local cafe, optimized for older adults.

spacing.rule: Accessibility First: Extremely generous spacing. All tap targets must be 56pt minimum. Avoid dense clustering. Single column layouts preferred.

do's: Use solid colors and gentle gradient backdrops for hero areas only.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. It reduces contrast and creates visual confusion for older adults, violating core accessibility requirements.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Warmly introduce the app, present the butterfly motif, and offer highly visible, large login/signup buttons.

states.error: Clear message: 'We couldn't connect. Please try again.' with a large Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero background image (friends at coffee) with a top-down gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Large butterfly logo at the top center. Massive tagline 'Find Your People.' and secondary 'Because You Belong Too.' below it. The bottom 40% contains extremely large (minHeight 64pt) pill-shaped buttons for Auth: Sign Up, Log In, Apple, Google.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Serve as the simple, uncrowded starting point with large tiles for all major community features.
screens.layout: A 2-column grid of large, chunky tiles. Each tile uses a 'brandTertiary' tinted background with a massive, distinct filled Ionicon and a 22pt title. Tiles: Coffee Lounge (spans full width at top), Find Friends, Local Events, Community Groups, Notice Board, Games, Profile. Top header has greeting and points total.

screens.name: Coffee Lounge
screens.purpose: The core real-time feature: allow users to browse and join active 'virtual tables' for live text/audio chat.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty cafe table with text 'No active tables right now. Start one!' and a large CTA.

screens.layout: Vertical list. Each 'Table' (e.g., Morning Coffee, Book Club) is a massive card with a soft shadow (tier 2). Inside: Large 22pt Table Name, a row of oversized avatar circles showing who is seated, and a bold, pill-shaped 'Join Table' CTA. A sticky 'Create Table' FAB sits at the bottom.

welcome_hero.alt: Three seniors talking and smiling together at a cafe

coffee_lounge_hero.alt: Older men chatting over coffee at a cafe table

community_events.alt: Seniors gathering and smiling at a community event

instructions_to_main_agent: ACCESSIBILITY ZERO TOLERANCE: Base font size is 18pt. Button labels are 22pt. The minimum height for any Pressable or Button is 56pt, preferably 64pt for primary CTAs.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, blur effects, or muddy dark backgrounds. Use solid, high-contrast surfaces. This is critical for older adults.
Navigation must be flat and explicit. Avoid hidden gestures, swipe-to-delete, or deep nested menus. Always provide a clear 'Back' or 'Home' button.
Theme: Tactile / Playful structure (chunky cards, large pills) but with a mature Teal & Blue palette. The vibe should be a warm, welcoming community lounge.
For the Welcome screen image, ensure the top-to-bottom gradient scrim is dark enough at the bottom (>=80% surfaceInverse) so the white text is perfectly legible.
Coffee Lounge 'Virtual Tables': Render these as large, inviting cards. The avatar stack of people currently at the table is the focal point, paired with a massive 'Join Table' button.
Ensure the layout relies on a single column or a very simple 2-column grid. Avoid clutter. Whitespace is a navigation aid for this demographic.
